mechanism: 헤지펀드 주주행동주의의 변화가 동일 투입에서의 생산효율 경로를 통해 기업 총요소생산성의 증가로 이어질 수 있다는 조건부 설명 초안이다.
conditions: 논문의 처치·결과 정의와 대상 기업의 변수 정의가 일치할 것
논문의 모집단·시기·제도 및 효과 발생 시차가 적용 대상과 부합할 것

원자료 R03855의 적용 맥락: This paper studies the long-term real effects of hedge‑fund activism in the United States by matching activism events (mainly 1994–2007, with plant data through 2009) to plant‑level manufacturing data (Census CMF/ASM/LBD) and firm databases (Compustat/CRSP). The units are manufacturing plants and their parent firms targeted by activists (identified primarily via SEC Schedule 13D filings). The institutional setting is U.S. capital markets and disclosure rules; activists typically hold concentrated stakes and push strategic, asset‑sale, governance, and capital‑allocation changes, with outcomes measured in plant TFP, asset reallocation, employment, wages, and IT investment.
